environment.description: Kubernetes pod running in CI namespace with default service account. Pod has unrestricted egress NetworkPolicy. Internal metadata service at 169.254.169.254 and internal APIs on 10.0.0.0/8 are reachable. The webhook-validator is invoked by a pipeline step that accepts user-provided webhook URLs from merge request descriptions. No service mesh or mTLS is enforced on the cluster ingress.
